summary: Frontend-only regression pass for Revision 3 Part 1 (paged lesson renderer + pretest/exercise blocks + interactive SVG viz + [[Term]] glossary links + takeaway saving + /quiz/review). Almost every spec item PASSES. Detailed findings: (A) /lesson/L02 opens directly (no unlock friction), lesson-screen mounts, lesson-position starts at '1/7' with 7 segment bars, lesson-exit (✕) present. lesson-prev is correctly hidden on slide 1 and lesson-next steps through 2/7..7/7 with position updating live; on slide 7 lesson-next is gone and go-to-quiz is shown. (B) Slide 2 pretest: prompt with '[[Equity]]' renders term-equity link. Tap on pretest-option-2 renders pretest-feedback with the exact option-2 text 'Hai diviso 50 per 150: manca il tuo call nel piatto finale, che è 200.'; pretest-option-0 becomes aria-disabled=true (other options disabled). Tapping term-equity navigates to /glossary with glossary-search value 'Equity' prefilled; browser Back returns to slide 2 at 2/7. (C) Slide 3 visual PotOddsBar: potodds-required initially shows '25.0%'; six potodds-slider-inc taps drive bet 50→80 and required equity to ~30.8% (CountUp read mid-animation was 30.4%, then converged to 30.8), verdict box flips from '✓ Call' to '✕ Fold' (hero equity 30%); three -dec taps reduce it back to 28.7%. Slider drag not explicitly automated (pan gesture on web is handled via gesture-handler); inc/dec + code review confirm the pan handler exists. (D) Slide 4: block-formula visible with 'equity richiesta = call / (piatto + 2 × call)'; term-pot-odds link tap → /glossary with glossary-search 'Pot odds' prefilled, back returns to 4/7. (E) Slide 5: example block ('Piatto finale: 100 + 50 + 50 = 200') and warning callout ('Errore comune: dividere per 150') both render. (F) Slide 6 exercises: exercise-0 → input '20' → exercise-feedback contains 'Hai diviso per 150. Il piatto finale è 60 + 30 + 30 = 120.'; exercise-retry then '25' → '✓ 30 su 120. Il tuo call è nel piatto finale.'; exercise-next → exercise-1 → '50' → feedback contains 'manca il tuo call' as required; exercise-skip → exercise-2 → '20' → correct feedback '50 su 250…'; exercise-next → exercise-done shows '✓ Esercizi completati · 2/3'. (G) Slide 7: block-takeaway visible; save-takeaway label toggles 'Salva nel glossario' → '✓ Salvata nel glossario'. Profile (nav-profile) → open-glossary shows saved-rules section with saved-rule-L02 card. (H) go-to-quiz opens /quiz/L02 and quiz-check is mounted. (I) Old-format lessons: /lesson/L01 mounts as 1/2 (2 slides, not 1/1 as the request stated - see note); outs-dot-5 tap yields outs-estimate '≈ 24%' (6 outs × 4); outs-turn toggle yields '≈ 12%'. /lesson/L08 mounts, mdf-value/alpha-value present (initial 60%/40%); 6× mdf-slider-inc changes them to 51%/49%. /lesson/L07 mounts and vb-row-0 is tappable. All L01..L10 open without crash and step through every slide to go-to-quiz. (J) Review quiz: seeded conceptMastery with 3 overdue concepts (outs/equity/pot_odds, score<60) yields home-review-badge='3'; tapping home-review navigates to /quiz/review (URL confirmed); the quiz has 3 questions and quiz-done returns to /study without crash. HOWEVER, the /quiz/review header shows 'Quiz · 1/3' (the generic HeaderBar template at app/quiz/[id].tsx:101), not 'Ripasso misto'. The buildReview() lesson.title is set to it.glossary.review ('Ripasso misto') but never displayed - see minor issue below. (K) Sim regression: nav-home 'Gioca una sessione' → /sim start-session → /table; action-fold triggers verdict-sheet with 4 SVGs (EV bar chart + verdict content rendered, all EV rows visible: All-in 1.2, Raise 33% 1.2, Call 1.0bb 0.2, Fold 0.0). Report screen ScoreTimeline was not directly reached in-run because the session is 20 hands and there is no observable early-exit button (only the top-back arrow); the code path (app/table.tsx:112 router.replace('/report')) and report.tsx (ScoreTimeline imported and rendered) are correct. (L) Zero console errors / pageerrors and no reanimated/gesture-handler warnings captured across the full 6-script run.

ui_bugs.issue: Review quiz header always renders 'Quiz · N/M' (HeaderBar title on line 101). Spec expects header 'Ripasso misto' for /quiz/review. buildReview() correctly sets lesson.title = it.glossary.review but the value is never surfaced.

action_items: In /app/frontend/app/quiz/[id].tsx line 101, use lesson.title when isReview (or always) so /quiz/review shows the 'Ripasso misto' header per spec. Suggested: `<HeaderBar title={isReview ? lesson.title : `Quiz · ${index + 1}/${total}`} … />` (or append the counter).

Optional: verify pan-drag on the Slider track on web (gesture-handler mouse events). inc/-dec buttons and value math were validated; a manual pan-drag was not scripted because Playwright mouse events on gesture-handler tracks can be flaky; consider adding a testID on the track and a dedicated e2e later.
critical_code_review_comments: app/lesson/[id].tsx cleanly separates the paged renderer from block rendering; SectionLabel + Heading + per-slide FadeIn works well; save-takeaway is only mounted for slide.role==='takeaway' (correct). Position/segments update via useState index; KeyboardAwareScrollView remounts on index change with key={index} - good for resetting scroll.

src/features/lesson/blocks.tsx PretestBlock disables further taps via `disabled={picked != null}` and dims non-picked options to opacity 0.5. ExerciseBlock matchFeedback covers value/below/above wrong branches and falls back gracefully; the 'skip after wrong' path lets students continue, which matches spec.
src/ui/Slider.tsx uses runOnJS(fromX) on pan begin+update so onChange fires synchronously - value updates are immediate; step buttons are 44x44 (accessible).

src/viz/charts.tsx PotOddsBar computes required equity live and shows the flip verdict as a colored callout; MdfAlphaCurve and OutsCounter are fully interactive; ScoreTimeline dot color flips negative when a hand-over-hand drop occurs.

app/glossary.tsx correctly consumes savedTakeaways to render saved-rules with saved-rule-<id> cards; glossary-search is a controlled TextInput and receives the term via useLocalSearchParams (verified via prefill test).
app/quiz/[id].tsx buildReview() aggregates due concepts across all lessons - solid; but its lesson.title is never rendered (HeaderBar hardcodes 'Quiz · N/M') - see UI bug above.
app/(tabs)/index.tsx home-review-badge only mounts when due.length>0; when no concepts are due the pill still navigates to /study (via the fallback in router.push guard) - matches spec.
No deprecated Expo packages spotted (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch references).

success_rate.frontend: 97% (all core flows PASS; only nit: /quiz/review header text)

seed_data_creation: Test seeded localStorage key poker_academy_state_v3 (double-JSON-stringified as AsyncStorage web shim does) with all lessons in 'read' state and 3 overdue conceptMastery entries (outs/equity/pot_odds) to force home-review-badge and populate the review quiz.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The web AsyncStorage shim writes JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(state)) under key 'poker_academy_state_v3'. To seed state via localStorage you MUST double-encode. Onboarding must be completed via UI first (onboarding-skip → level-basics → onboarding-next) before setItem sticks; otherwise the app persists a fresh (defaulted) profile on first save. Report/ScoreTimeline can only be reached by playing 20 hands (no early-exit testID). Web preview URL is https://hand-simulator-2.preview.emergentagent.com. No console errors observed anywhere. Iteration 3 context still applies for tabs and navigation.
rca_of_issue: Review header shows 'Quiz · N/M' regardless of isReview because HeaderBar title at app/quiz/[id].tsx:101 is templated with the question index/total. buildReview builds the review lesson with title=it.glossary.review ('Ripasso misto') but that title is not passed to HeaderBar. Fix: replace the title prop with `isReview ? lesson.title : `Quiz · ${index + 1}/${total}`` (or `${lesson.title} · ${index+1}/${total}` if the counter must remain visible).
